title: Sri Lankan Splendor
highlights: Explore the historic Temple of the Tooth Relic, witness traditional Kandyan dance performances, and take a leisurely stroll around the picturesque Kandy Lake
Immerse yourself in the charm of 'Little England,' surrounded by mist-covered hills and lush tea plantations
Embark on a boat ride along the Bentota River, encountering diverse wildlife and serene natural surroundings
Indulge in the flavors of Sri Lankan cuisine and savor fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and traditional dishes at the beachside restaurants in Bentota
Explore the narrow streets filled with shops, street vendors, and the lively atmosphere of Pettah Market
overview:
About the Tour:
Enjoy a 5-day journey through the diverse landscapes and cultural tapestry of Sri Lanka. Immerse yourself in the local way of life as you navigate bustling markets and witness the spiritual resonance of the Temple of the Tooth Relic. Kandy, with its traditional dance performances and the serene Kandy Lake, provides a captivating introduction to the country's rich heritage. Explore Nuwara Eliya, aptly named 'Little England,' where the colonial charm meets lush tea plantations. A leisurely exploration of its streets unveils a fusion of colonial architecture and local influences, offering a unique perspective on Sri Lanka's historical narrative. Engage with the art of tea-making in the surrounding estates, deepening your connection to the region's economic and cultural roots.
Continue your sojourn to Bentota, a coastal retreat where golden sands meet the turquoise waters of the Indian Ocean. Whether unwinding on the beaches or participating in water sports, Bentota caters to a spectrum of preferences. A serene boat safari along the Bentota River adds a touch of nature to the coastal allure, allowing you to witness local wildlife and absorb the peaceful surroundings. Culminate your journey in Colombo, the bustling capital where modernity and tradition converge. From the historical insights of the National Museum to the spiritual ambiance of Gangaramaya Temple, Colombo offers a vibrant kaleidoscope of experiences. Conclude your Sri Lankan adventure with a leisurely stroll along Galle Face Green, capturing the city's dynamic spirit against the backdrop of the Indian Ocean.
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Sightseeing Tour of Colombo
1 night stay in Kandy with breakfast
1 night stay in Nuwara Eliya with breakfast
1 night stay in Bentota with breakfast
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Colombo to Kandy | Explore the life of Sri Lankan Elephants in Pinnawala
days.desc: Upon your arrival, the representative will pick you up from Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your hotel in Kandy. On the way, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and see rescued Asian Elephants. Upon your arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, take in the panoramic view of the town from Upper Lake Drive & enjoy a Kandyan Dance performance. After exploration, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Kandy.
In the evening, the representative will pick you up from the hotel in Kandy and take you for Upper Lake Drive.
After the drive, get transferred to witness the Kandyan Dance performance
After the dance, the representative will take you back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

items.title: Sightseeing Tour of Colombo
items.desc:
Explore the orphanage grounds, observe feeding sessions, and learn about the orphanage's efforts at elephant conservation.
Take a relaxing stroll along the perimeter of Kandy Lake and take in scenic vistas of the surroundings.
Enjoy a Kandyan Dance performance and admire the vibrant and elaborate costumes worn by the dancers.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | Explore The Little England
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival in Nuwara Eliya, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya. Visit a tea plantation and get to know about its production. Then, head to the Hanuman Temple. Continue to the beautiful Ramboda Falls. Head to the famous Seetha Amman Kovil. Then, visit Hakgala Botanical Gardens. After sightseeing, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to Nuwara Eliya.
Upon arrival in the city, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya.
After sightseeing, get transferred to your pre-booked hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Take a leisurely stroll through the picturesque tea plantations and learn about the cultivation process.
Visit the Hanuman Temple, a serene Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Hanuman and admire the intricate architecture of the temple.
Visit the Ramboda Falls, one of Sri Lanka's highest waterfalls and marvel at the vistas of cascading water surrounded by lush greenery.
Explore the Seetha Amman Kovil, a Hindu temple steeped in cultural and religious significance and learn about the temple's association with the Ramayana legend.
Wander through the Hakgala Botanical Gardens and explore themed gardens, including the rose garden and fernery, showcasing a variety of plant species from different regions.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota | Visit The Mirissa Beach
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Visit Madhu River, where you can enjoy a scenic boat ride. Then, head to Mirissa Beach. You can visit Coconut Tree Hill and marvel at the panoramic views of Mirissa Beach. You can also join a whale-watching tour. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Bentota.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Bentota.
Post sightseeing, the representative will take you back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Visit Madu River and enjoy a relaxing stroll along the river with scenic vistas.
You can enjoy a boat ride along the river and see dense mangrove forests.
Relax and sunbathe on Mirrisa Beach and take in the picturesque views of the shore.
You can spot the famous Parrot Rock, a huge red-colored mound that towers over the water.
You can also visit Coconut Tree Hill and take in the panoramic views of Mirissa Beach and the Indian Ocean. 
You can also join a whale watching tour and see  majestic blue whales, sperm whales, and dolphins in their natural habitat.

days.title: Bentota To Colombo | The Commercial Capital of Sri Lanka
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Colombo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Colombo. Explore the Colombo Fort and visit the Old Dutch Hospital. Then, take in the views of the city from the Lotus Tower. Continue to Lover’s Island. Head to World Trade Building and see the city from a different perspective. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and transfer you to your pre-booked hotel in Colombo.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Colombo.
Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Marvel at the architecture of the Colombo Fort Railway Station, a colonial-era train station at the Colombo Fort.
Explore the narrow streets lined with shops selling spices, textiles, and a variety of goods at the bustling Pettah Market.
Marvel at the panoramic views of Colombo's skyline from the observation deck at Lotus Tower.
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the scenic promenade by the ocean at Lover's Island.
Take in the views of the city from a different perspective from the World Trade Center.

days.title: Departure | Take a Bag Full of Memories
days.desc: After breakfast, pack your bags and check out from your hotel. The representative will pick you up and transfer you to Bandaranaike International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Bandaranaike International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.
